notes: v2.5.41. Show levels keeps the tree, several parts rev in one sheet, leaf assemblies rev, On hold replaces Blocked, a release audit page, and release documents look right in AOS. A cleaner eBOM toolbar, Add never leaves its lock behind, and the MTF tab stays on MTF. Very large parts get a 3D model, a failed model tile says why, and 3D pre-convert runs on a schedule. The mBOM gets a part journey flow chart, every CNC card links to its eBOM part, finished CNC cards are kept, an engineer can delete a router a teammate made, and finished builds leave the Global planner. One date picker everywhere, quotes export to Excel, tool calibration reminders, and clearer Access tab rows. This release also updates the database behind AOS, so please update as soon as you are prompted.
